name: Cool Breeze
description_html:
A light, uplifting assortment of white hydrangea, alstroemeria and roses.

Get lifted. Clouds of white hydrangea and mini carnations surrounded by gentle alstroemeria and roses lighten the energy and bring inspiration. Blue-green eucalyptus parvifolia completes the air-inspired arrangement. 

Pro Tip: Your flowers will arrive fresh in our recyclable Bouqs box and may still be in bud form. This maximizes their shelf life, so they’ll last as long as possible! Please allow 2-3 days for your new buds to open and reach full bloom.

Please Note: While we always try our best to match the bouquet pictured, we remain dedicated to fresh, high-quality flowers. Occasionally substitutions including color variation or supplemental flower type may occur to ensure you receive our farmers’ freshest possible selection.

Due to local restrictions, this Bouq cannot be delivered to Hawaii.

name: Swell
description_html:
Blue hydrangea plant in a woven basket.

An effortlessly chic blue hydrangea plant in a woven basket, designed to light up someone’s day and instantly refresh any space. Each hydrangea plant coloring is unique and may vary in shades of blue and purple.

Care Instructions: Keep in bright, indirect sunlight and water soil 2-3 times per week.

Shipping Note: Guaranteed delivery by date selected at checkout, but could arrive up to 2 days sooner. Cannot ship to Alaska or Hawaii.

name: The Elegance Party Box
description_html:
DIY Party Box featuring white roses, lilies and hydrangeas.

Please note this item is excluded from promotions. 

What to Expect: DIY Party Boxes do not arrive arranged. Rather you will receive a box of loose stems, ready for some DIY fun. 
How it ships: These will arrive in an extra-large box (approx. 38"x12"x5") and weigh approximately 13lbs. The box will contain multiple bunches of stems, carefully wrapped so they are protected during transport. 
Suggested Prep: We recommend planning ahead, as processing and arranging your stems into arrangements or installations takes time and space. 

  1. Remove all flowers from packaging. 
  2. Process your flowers by hydrating them in a cool space. Once hydrated, trim the stems at a 45-degree angle and remove any leaves that’ll fall below the water line. 
  3. Start arranging!  

Learn more about processing flowers here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FypUVkPsyMo&t=5s
